newsitem.title: USA: Initial Acquisition to Merge with Hollis-Eden.
newsitem.headline: Initial Acquisition to Merge with Hollis-Eden.

text.p: Initial Acquisition Corp on Wednesday said it has agreed to merge with Hollis-Eden Inc, a bio-pharmaceutical company.

The agreement calls for the issuance of one share of the Initial common stock for each outstanding share of Hollis-Eden common stock and the conversion of all outstanding Hollis-Eden warrants and options into options and warrants of Initial.
Initial will issue 4,911,004 shares of common stock as well as 2,229,650 options and warrants, the firm said. After the merger, the firm's name will be changed to Hollis-Eden Pharmaceuticals Inc.

With completion of the merger, Hollis-Eden Pharmaceuticals Inc expects to become listed on Nasdaq or the American Stock Exchange. Richard B. Hollis, Chairman of Hollis-Eden will become chairman, president and chief executive of the firm.

Hollis-Eden is engaged in the development of therapeutic and preventative agents for the treatment of viral and immune disorders. It believes that its drug, INACTIVIN, presents the potential for a treatment of HIV/AIDS.
Richard Hollis, chairman of Hollis-Eden, said in a statement: "This merger will provide resources to enable Hollis-Eden to conduct human clinical trials to advance our products with the FDA."
